description: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore managed security harness with deterministic inline tools

tools.name: read_mock_s3
tools.description: Read approved synthetic AWS S3 bucket configurations for security analysis. Returns resource ID, public access settings, policy findings, and evidence ID.

tools.name: read_mock_security_groups
tools.description: Read approved synthetic AWS EC2 security-group ingress rules for security analysis. Returns security-group ID, protocol, port, CIDR, exposure finding, and evidence ID.

tools.name: propose_fix
tools.description: Submit a safe remediation fix proposal for a validated security finding. Status will be PENDING human review.
